name: Mikoto
source:
A girl who is entered into Kaen Academy, where the 'flowers' attend, as a result of a certain incident. 
Though clumsy, she's easily drawn to things and learns more about the world of 'Hana Awase', becoming absorbed in it.
Her interests are cooking, sewing and card games.

[Translated from the [url=http://hana-awase.net/M/]official website[/url]]
